title: scabiosa virens
intro: Scabiosa virens, commonly known as the green scabious or pincushion flower, is a plant species in the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Scabiosa virens include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Scabiosa virens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
